product_name: Small-Animal Habitat Bedding Sifter & Waste Scoop Combo

target_buyer.description: An owner of a small caged animal (hamster, gerbil, guinea pig, rabbit) doing routine spot-cleaning who has been using a cat litter scoop that either lets fine bedding through or fails to separate soiled clumps from clean bedding
target_buyer.context: My cat litter scoop either lets everything through or catches nothing when I use it on my hamster's cage.

must_keep: sifter mesh gauge (3mm) specifically calibrated to pass paper/aspen bedding fines while retaining soiled clumps and pellets
must_avoid: a supplier widening the mesh gauge to speed up molding, letting fine bedding fall through with the waste and causing customers to over-discard clean bedding

user_hypotheses: A small-animal owner frustrated that a repurposed cat-litter scoop either passes everything or nothing will buy a sifter/scoop combo specifically because its mesh gauge is calibrated for bedding fines rather than clumping litter
